attributes.name: Brian C Rogers
attributes.blurb: Retired Chairman & Chief Investment Officer, T. Rowe Price Group, Inc.
attributes.summary: Brian C. Rogers has been a director of Price Group since 1997, the chairman of the board since 2007, the chief investment officer since 2004, a vice president since 1985, and an employee since 1982. He is a member of the Executive Committee. Mr. Rogers serves as a director or trustee of 26 Price fund companies and is the president of three Price fund companies.
